name: Bamboo Floor Refinishing in Sammamish: When It Works and When It Doesn't
title-tag: Bamboo Floor Refinishing in Sammamish: When It Works
meta-description: Can bamboo floors be refinished? Solid and strand-woven usually can; engineered often can't. A Sammamish contractor on telling them apart — and when to replace.
post-summary: January 6, 2027 · Bamboo is three different floors wearing one name: solid refinishes well, strand-woven fights the sander but sands, and engineered lives or dies by its veneer. How to tell which one the 2000s remodel wave left in your Sammamish home, and when replacement is the honest call.
